notes:
v1.0.48 - CurseForge installs fixed (no more Modrinth errors).

CurseForge search results showed up fine, but clicking Install mentioned
Modrinth and failed: the install confirmation modal was hardcoded to
Modrinth (detail/versions/deps loaded from Modrinth, install calls used
the Modrinth-only paths with the CurseForge numeric id). The modal is now
provider-aware: CurseForge items load through the proxy, install through
installVersion with the real provider, and get a single Install button
(CurseForge exposes no dependency tree, so items install alone).
ProjectDetail also routes CurseForge before the Modrinth-only shift-click
dependency path. Modrinth behavior is unchanged. Verified live against
the proxy (search -> files -> download-url -> real jar download).
